subject: Re: FintechCo discovery - next steps & re-engagement plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: FintechCo discovery - no response from Priya / internal alignment before re-contact

Team - quick sync. I did the discovery with Priya Sharma (FintechCo) on 2026-02-25 and sent the recap + sample throughput numbers last week (attached notes). No response to my follow-up yet.

Context: they were evaluating inference cost vs latency tradeoffs for a document understanding pipeline (shortish inputs, many concurrent users). They liked our batching/caching approach but flagged price sensitivity and a required SOC2 + data residency conversation.

Ask: before I bump Priya again, can we align on the following so outreach is tight?
- Dev: confirm the lightweight pilot proposal (1 GPU, 10k monthly tokens, 30-day trial) and the minimal SLO we can commit to for demonstration.
- Logan (CS): priority ask - can you provide a short success play (what metrics we want to show during the pilot and a one-week onboarding checklist)?
- Laura: any guidance on discount guardrails / approvals if they push back on price?

I plan to send a short re-engagement email (1\u20132 lines) + proposed pilot plan on Monday 2026-03-09 unless you advise otherwise. I attached the discovery notes and a draft playbook.

Thanks - Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-03-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCo discovery - no response from Priya / internal alignment before re-contact

Got it - thanks for the context and the notes. Quick technical answers:
- Pilot configuration: 1 p4d-like instance equivalent (quantized model), 10k tokens/day cap (configurable). We can commit to a 95th%-ile p99 latency target of ~120ms for the short request sizes they described, assuming prefix caching is enabled and batch window of 20ms. I'll validate with benchmarking by EOD.
- Security/data residency: we can offer a Dedicated pilot in a US region with KMS integration; that'll address their SOC2/residency ask during trial. There may be a 2\u20133 week provisioning lead time for Dedicated, but for demo we can simulate with strict VPC/network controls in hosted and escalate to Dedicated if they sign.

I'll attach a quick runbook for the demo (low-friction steps) after I run the microbenchmarks. If you want, I can include a two-slide tech summary to send with the re-engagement note.

- Dev

--
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-03-06T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCo discovery - no response from Priya / internal alignment before re-contact

Marissa - happy to own the pilot success plan. Suggested metrics to commit to and monitor during the 30-day pilot:
- Time-to-first-byte and p95/p99 latency for representative request set
- Per-request token cost and projected monthly cost at their estimated qps
- Error rate and retries (goal <0.5%)

Onboarding checklist (one-pager):
1) Data access: SFTP/secure upload + sample dataset (we keep sample small).
2) API keys + test harness (we provide collection script).
3) Initial run: baseline latency/cost.
4) Weekly checkpoints (we'll do two 30-min check-ins).

I'll draft the one-pager and share by tomorrow. If we need to scale the pilot to Dedicated for residency, let's note the provisioning window so Marissa can set expectations.

- Logan

--
Logan Wright

Thanks for the loop. High-level on commercial flexibility:
- For a first pilot focused on proving latency/cost, we can approve up to a 15% one-time pilot credit. Anything beyond that needs manager sign-off (I can approve up to 25% for strategic accounts).
- If procurement pushes for extended term discounts, route to me and include ARR/expansion signal.

If Marissa is planning a short bump email, include the pilot offer (15% credit) and the suggested timeline (30-day pilot + two weekly checkpoints). That usually helps re-engage price-sensitive buyers.

Laura

Perfect - thanks all. Plan of record:
1) Dev to run quick microbenchmarks and send the two-slide tech summary by EOD 2026-03-09.
2) Logan to share the one-page onboarding checklist and pilot success metrics by 2026-03-10.
3) I will send a short re-engagement email to Priya on 2026-03-10 with: 1-line bump, proposed 30-day pilot (1 GPU-equivalent, 10k tokens/day), 15% pilot credit, and a link to the two-slide tech summary + onboarding one-pager.

Draft of the outreach (please comment inline):
"Hi Priya - hope you're well. Quick follow-up from our discovery: wanted to see if you had time to continue the conversation this month. We can spin up a 30-day pilot (1 GPU-equivalent, 10k tokens/day) to demonstrate latency and cost; we'll include a 15% pilot credit and two weekly checkpoints. Would next Tuesday or Thursday work for a short 20-30 minute kick-off? I've attached a short tech note and checklist for context."

If no objections I'll send Monday morning PST. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

- Marissa
